description: An enterprise-grade ecommerce platform offering flexible B2B and B2C online store management and catalog solutions.
auth_notes: Supports token-based authentication (administrator or customer tokens via bearer tokens) and OAuth authentication.
credential_notes: Adobe Commerce (Magento Open Source) can be self-hosted or run locally for free by developers to generate API credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive API coverage for products, categories, customers, carts, orders, and inventory via REST, GraphQL, and SOAP.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Adobe; community-created integrations may exist.
rationale: Magento Open Source is freely downloadable and locally deployable with a robust, fully documented REST, GraphQL, and SOAP API surface.

evidence.note: Provides documentation and tools for integrating and extending Adobe Commerce/Magento.
